title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → Institution
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: Installation controls: institution name and base settings. One row for the home institution.
Campus validation. Map campuses as locations unless they report to IPEDS separately.
Source/background institution validation: every high school and college a student came from, keyed by SBGI code (usually CEEB/ACT code).
Source/background institution base: address (city, state, nation) for each SBGI code.

notes: Load the home institution from GUBINST and external schools from STVSBGI/SOBSBGI (filter to colleges; STVSBGI also holds high schools, which belong elsewhere). FLAG: GUBINST column names differ across Banner releases; confirm.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution code (home) or STVSBGI_CODE (external).
Direct. FLAG: confirm the GUBINST name column.
Banner has no short name for the home institution.
Array of {system, value}: banner_sbgi (SBGI code, usually CEEB for colleges), ipeds_unit_id, opeid, fice. Add IPEDS and OPEID from configuration or the IPEDS directory file.
STVSBGI type C (college) vs H (high school) filters the list; the HELIX type comes from IPEDS level and control.
Convert the Banner nation code to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Null nation means US at most schools.
Direct for US; ISO 3166-2 for others.
Load from the Carnegie Classification public file by IPEDS Unit ID. Refresh when a new edition is published.
IANA name, for example America/New_York. Set once per institution or campus.
'banner' for the home institution. Null for external schools.
